description: Production overview for the OpenPage host, application containers, PostgreSQL container and monitoring stack. Uses only Prometheus, node-exporter and cAdvisor metrics.

panels.description: Percentage of configured Prometheus targets currently reporting up. See Monitoring health for the up/total breakdown.
panels.title: Targets healthy

panels.description: Current Docker containers reported by cAdvisor. Empty names and the root cgroup are excluded; No data is retained when cAdvisor is down.

targets.expr: count(count(container_last_seen{job="cadvisor", name!="", name!="/", id!="/"}) by (name)) and on() (up{job="cadvisor"} == 1)

panels.title: Docker containers

panels.description: Expected OpenPage containers currently observed by cAdvisor. Four is healthy.
panels.title: OpenPage containers

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs|overlay"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs|overlay"})

panels.description: Swap usage is shown only when the host has swap configured; otherwise the panel remains No data.
panels.title: Swap

panels.description: Non-idle CPU time split by operationally relevant modes.
panels.title: CPU usage by mode

panels.description: No data is expected when swap is not configured.
panels.title: Swap capacity

panels.description: Average read/write operation latency and device busy time. No data is retained when the underlying counters are absent.
panels.title: Disk latency and I/O time

panels.description: Pseudo filesystems, overlay filesystems and Docker/container mounts are excluded.
panels.title: Filesystem usage

panels.description: Allocated host file descriptors as a percentage of the kernel limit.
panels.title: File descriptors

panels.description: Absolute memory and storage values. Swap rows are absent when swap is not configured; missing source metrics are never replaced with zero.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "RAM used", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "RAM available", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "RAM total", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs|overlay"} - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs|overlay"}), "metric", "Root filesystem used", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs|overlay"}), "metric", "Root filesystem available", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", mountpoint="/", fstype!~"rootfs|tmpfs|overlay"}), "metric", "Root filesystem total", "", "") or label_replace((sum(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"} - node_memory_SwapFree_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}) and sum(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}) > 0), "metric", "Swap used", "", "") or label_replace((sum(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}) and sum(node_memory_SwapTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}) > 0), "metric", "Swap total", "", "")

panels.title: Capacity snapshot

panels.description: Current host scheduler and process values. Context switches are a per-second rate; the remaining values are absolute counts or load averages.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(node_load1{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "Load average — 1 minute", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_load5{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "Load average — 5 minutes", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_load15{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "Load average — 15 minutes", "", "") or label_replace(count(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}) by (cpu)), "metric", "Logical CPUs", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_procs_running{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "Processes running", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_procs_blocked{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "Processes blocked", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_filefd_allocated{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "File descriptors allocated", "", "") or label_replace(sum(node_filefd_maximum{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}), "metric", "File descriptors maximum", "", "") or label_replace(sum(rate(node_context_switches_total{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance"}[$__rate_interval])), "metric", "Context switches / second", "", "")

panels.title: Host activity snapshot

panels.description: Current aggregate throughput. Virtual/container host interfaces are excluded from network totals; disk totals include physical block devices only.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|virbr.*"}[$__rate_interval])), "metric", "Network receive", "", "") or label_replace(sum(rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", device!~"lo|veth.*|docker.*|br-.*|virbr.*"}[$__rate_interval])), "metric", "Network transmit", "", "") or label_replace(sum(rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", device=~"[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|mmcblk[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])), "metric", "Disk read", "", "") or label_replace(sum(rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{job="node-exporter", instance="$node_instance", device=~"[a-z]+|nvme[0-9]+n[0-9]+|mmcblk[0-9]+"}[$__rate_interval])), "metric", "Disk write", "", "")

panels.title: Throughput snapshot

panels.description: One means observed; zero means missing. If cAdvisor itself is down, the panel remains No data instead of reporting all containers missing.
panels.title: Expected container presence

panels.description: Container start time is exposed by cAdvisor. A restart counter is intentionally omitted because cAdvisor does not export one.
panels.title: Container uptime

panels.description: Ratio is shown only for finite cAdvisor memory limits below 1 PB; unlimited sentinel values remain No data.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor", name=~"openpage-n-(backend|frontend|gateway|postgres)-1", id!="/"}) / sum by (name) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="cadvisor", name=~"openpage-n-(backend|frontend|gateway|postgres)-1", id!="/"} < 1e15)

panels.title: Memory working set / limit

panels.description: Current values for the selected OpenPage container(s). Process/thread columns are omitted because the cAdvisor process metric set is disabled in the current compose configuration.
panels.title: Current OpenPage container resources

panels.description: Number of configured targets currently down. This is derived directly from up and is not coerced when the metric itself is absent.
panels.title: Target failures / total

panels.description: Current local TSDB block storage reported by Prometheus. WAL and head memory are not included in this metric.
panels.title: Prometheus stored data

panels.description: Monitoring containers are selected by image so the query does not depend on the compose project directory name.
panels.title: Monitoring container CPU

panels.description: Age of the most recent successful up=1 sample within the selected dashboard range. A target with no success in range remains No data.
panels.title: Time since last successful scrape

panels.description: Presence of the four expected production containers. The query is gated by cAdvisor health, so exporter failure remains No data.
panels.title: Deployment container presence

panels.description: Raw cAdvisor last_seen timestamps. Gaps are preserved as No data.
panels.title: Container last seen

panels.description: Missing count is evaluated only while cAdvisor is up. Four expected names are defined by deploy/compose.yml.
panels.title: Expected OpenPage containers
